claims: NHS 111 is a free-to-call, non-emergency medical helpline in the UK.
Trained advisors and clinicians assess symptoms.
Trained advisors and clinicians direct to appropriate care, such as urgent treatment centers or local specialists.
NHS 111 connects directly to healthcare professionals.
In New Zealand, 111 is the emergency telephone number for police, fire, or ambulance services.
In numerology, 111 is considered an "angel number" representing new beginnings, opportunities, and alignment with goals.
